scoring_justification: The Sellmeier coefficients at the two temperatures are deterministically computed from the public temperature-dependent quadratic expansion; the checker recomputes the expected values and compares the submitted coefficients by relative tolerance.

outputs.description: Temperature-evaluated Sellmeier parameters a_i and b_i for each oscillator index at 20°C and 40°C, derived from the temperature-dependent quadratic expansion.

output_contract.notes: The agent must compute the coefficients exactly from the provided expansion coefficients. The checker will compare the submitted values to the correct values derived from the same expansion using a tight relative tolerance (≤0.001). Artifact shape: 6 rows, CSV with the declared columns.

hidden_assets.purpose: golden Sellmeier coefficients for T=20°C and T=40°C (a_i, b_i for i=1..3)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: recomputed from the provided quadratic expansion (Table 1 of the paper) using the same formulas the agent uses; the reference oracle's output at 8-digit precision serves as the exact gold.
hidden_assets.generation_method: The checker recomputes the expected values programmatically from the provided constants (embedded in the checker) and does not rely on a separate file.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The expansion constants are excerpted from the publicly cited paper (Table 1) and are the same values the agent is instructed to use; the resulting Sellmeier parameters are uniquely determined.

steps.description: Recompute expected a_i,b_i from the quadratic expansion and compare the agent's submitted values; score is the fraction of correctly matching cells (out of 12).
